title: Timeline of winter 1946‑47 referenced in passage
subject: History
caption: Timeline of the 1946‑47 winter showing start, peak, and end months
altText: A left‑to‑right flowchart representing the winter of 1946‑47. It begins with a pre‑winter node labeled October 1946, then proceeds to the start node November 1946, followed by December 1946, January 1947, February 1947 (marked as mid‑winter peak), March 1947, and ends with April 1947. Winter months are highlighted in light blue.
